title: Floor area modifications for certain paired districts
previewText:
In M1A Districts paired with Residence Districts, for zoning lots with buildings containing residential and non-residential uses, the maximum floor area ratio for individual uses on the zoning lot shall apply, but the total floor area ratio shall be modified as follows:
